# LaunchPulse

> Global SaaS directory distribution, 24/7 multi-source buyer intent radar, and verifiable Cloudflare Edge revenue attribution for indie founders and lean B2B teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **100+ Curated High-DR Directories**: Staggered 3-wave anti-sandbox submission pacing across verified software, AI, and developer directories with automated HTTP 200 and `dofollow` backlink checks.
- **24/7 Buyer Intent Radar**: Monitors Reddit, Hacker News, GitHub, and DEV.to for high-intent buying and competitor-alternative threads with a Zero-Link Safe Reply Studio.
- **Verifiable Edge Revenue Attribution**: Sub-10ms `/r/<code>` edge shortlinks and a 1-line conversion pixel (`window.lpConvert`) reconciling clicks, signups, and paid orders into shareable public growth reports.
